remarks: Five bedrooms and four bathrooms.Great Westport home strategically located.This charming property located at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac features lovely gardens, a great courtyard for entertaining and a private heated pool surrounded by decorative stonework. All beautifully landscaped.Home has an open plan conducive to abundant sunshine.Main floor features,an updated kitchen with new appliances which flows to a cozy family room with fireplace,dining room and inviting living room.Upstairs,the primary suite has an updated bath and dual closets.Surrounded by three other lovely bedrooms.The newly refinished lower level extends out to the pool and has a dazzling-space-great as a recreation/playroom as well as pool cabana w/wet bar & full bath to complete your poolside entertainment.The lower level has a bedroom/au pair/guest room/laundry.This home has a large 2 car garage, Central Air,many beautiful built-ins and stunning newly hdwd floors.Entire home recently updated and just a mile from the NYC train.Close to Main Street restaurants,shops,Longshore golf,tennis and Compo Beach.A crown jewel in Westport. A dog would be considered on a case by case basis and approved by property manager.Landlord will be responsible for opening and closing the pool and weekly maintenance.
